text: Election of the Vice Chair of the North York Community Council under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office starting December 11, 2018 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

North York Community Council: 1. Elected Councillor Shelley Carroll as Vice Chair of the North York Community Council for a term of office starting December 11, 2018 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
